chunks: From him, from al-Barqi, from Sa'd ibn Sa'd al-Ash'ari, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about the prayer on Friday, how many rak'ahs are there before midday? He said: 'Six rak'ahs in the morning, and six rak'ahs after that, twelve rak'ahs, and six rak'ahs after that, eighteen rak'ahs, and two rak'ahs after midday, so these are twenty rak'ahs, and two rak'ahs after Asr, so these are twenty-two rak'ahs.'

key_terms.قَبْلَ الزَّوَالِ: Before midday (when the sun begins to decline)

ai.seo_question: How many voluntary rak'ahs should be prayed on Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Rida (AS) outlines a comprehensive schedule of supererogatory prayers for Friday, emphasizing the virtue of multiplying acts of worship throughout the day. It reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of distinguishing between the specific Sunnah prayers of Friday and the broader recommended acts, highlighting the spiritual significance of dedicating the entire day to devotion. The detailed count underscores the importance of consistency and abundance in worship on this blessed day.
